projects.title: Real-Time IoT Temperature Analytics with Spark & Kafka
projects.shortDescription: Real-time temperature analysis from U.S. nationwide IoT sensors using Apache Spark and Kafka for streaming data processing and analytics.
projects.detailedDescription: Developed a comprehensive real-time data processing system for analyzing U.S. nationwide temperature data from IoT sensors using Apache Spark and Kafka. Built custom IoT data simulator to generate realistic temperature sensor data across multiple U.S. states. Implemented Kafka server for high-throughput data streaming and PySpark for real-time data processing and analytics. Created four key analytical capabilities: average temperature by state in descending order, total messages processed, number of sensors per state, and total sensor count. Successfully processed 10,000 simulated sensor data points from 2,086 sensors, demonstrating scalable IoT data processing pipeline. Project showcases modern big data technologies for real-time analytics and provides practical implementation of streaming data architecture for IoT applications.

projects.title: Data Pipeline with DBT, Airflow & BigQuery on GCP
projects.shortDescription: Modern data engineering pipeline using Astronomer, DBT, Soda, and Metabase with Apache Airflow orchestration on Google Cloud Platform.
projects.detailedDescription: Designed and implemented a comprehensive data engineering pipeline demonstrating modern data stack technologies on Google Cloud Platform. Built end-to-end workflow using Apache Airflow for orchestration, DBT for data transformation into star schema, Soda for data quality validation, and Metabase for visualization. Integrated Docker containerization for scalable deployment and used BigQuery as the data warehouse. Processed Online Retail II dataset from Kaggle containing UK-based online retailer transactions from 2009-2011. Implemented automated data quality checks, business logic transformations, and interactive dashboards. Project serves as a comprehensive learning platform for modern data engineering practices, showcasing industry-standard tools and methodologies for building reliable, scalable data pipelines.

projects.title: Machine Learning Fraud Detection on AWS
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive fraud detection system using XGBoost and RandomCutForest algorithms on AWS SageMaker for real-time transaction monitoring.
projects.detailedDescription: Developed a robust machine learning-based fraud detection system using AWS cloud services to combat online fraud and abuse. Implemented both supervised (XGBoost Gradient Boosted Decision Tree) and unsupervised (RandomCutForest) machine learning algorithms using Amazon SageMaker. Processed ULB credit card transaction dataset containing 284,807 transactions with 492 fraudulent cases, handling highly imbalanced data through upsampling and weight adjustment techniques. Built complete ML pipeline including data preprocessing, model training, real-time endpoint deployment, and REST API creation using Lambda and API Gateway. Implemented data storage and preprocessing with Kinesis Firehose for scalable transaction processing. System designed to be dynamic, self-improving, and maintainable, providing real-time fraud detection capabilities for financial institutions.

projects.title: Financial Insights Dashboard with PowerBI
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive banking analytics platform using PowerBI for transaction analysis, credit scoring, and branch performance evaluation.
projects.detailedDescription: Created a comprehensive financial analytics dashboard using PowerBI to transform banking transaction data into actionable business insights. Processed and analyzed two primary datasets: banking transactions and customer account details, implementing advanced data cleaning, transformation, and DAX calculations. Built interactive visualizations for transaction trend analysis, credit score evaluation, branch efficiency rating, and customer demographic analysis. Designed sophisticated branch performance metrics and customer segmentation capabilities. Delivered enhanced risk management tools through comprehensive credit score analysis and predictive modeling for account growth forecasting. Project demonstrates the power of data visualization in transforming raw banking data into strategic decision-making tools for financial institutions, providing detailed insights into customer behavior, operational efficiency, and business performance.

projects.title: Real-Time Fraud Detection Demo with Apache Flink
projects.shortDescription: Interactive real-time fraud detection system using Apache Flink and Kafka with containerized deployment and web interface.
projects.detailedDescription: Developed an interactive fraud detection demonstration system using Apache Flink for real-time stream processing and Kafka for data ingestion. Built comprehensive containerized solution using Docker and Docker Compose for easy deployment and scalability. Implemented web-based interface accessible at localhost:5656 for interactive demonstration and monitoring of fraud detection capabilities. Designed as a learning and educational platform to showcase modern streaming technologies and fraud detection techniques. Project emphasizes practical implementation of real-time analytics using industry-standard tools, providing hands-on experience with streaming data processing, fraud detection algorithms, and scalable system architecture. Serves as a comprehensive demo environment for understanding real-time fraud detection workflows and modern data engineering practices.
